packageRules.description: gin-swagger 1.x is not compatible with swaggo/files 2.x, see https://github.com/swaggo/gin-swagger/issues/264
runtime-spec v1.3.0 changed LinuxPids.Limit from int64 to *int64, which breaks podman v5 (<=v5.8.2) and runtime-tools (<=v0.9.0). Revisit once both ship releases supporting v1.3.0.

typescript 7.x is the native (Go/tsgo) compiler and drops the JS API the frontend toolchain relies on: vue-tsc still requires typescript/lib/tsc and typescript-eslint pins its peer to <6.1.0. Revisit once vue-tsc and typescript-eslint ship native TypeScript support.

These are pinned via `overrides` in docs/ and web/ package.json to keep bun lockfile generation deterministic. bun hoists a package non-deterministically when one consumer pins an exact version and another accepts a range spanning it, which made lockFileMaintenance flip-flop and open a new PR every run. Each pin is the lowest version all consumers accept, so a single copy is hoisted. Do not let Renovate bump them: internmap 2.x violates d3-sankey/d3-array's ^1.0.0, and enhanced-resolve >5.21.6 violates @tailwindcss/node's exact pin. Revisit once bun generates deterministic lockfiles.
